source: Malik (1990) JCP 86:376 Table VI, Case 5 (M=10, R=1000, adiabatic, alpha=0.12, beta=0). Dimensional conditions (T0=4200 degR, adiabatic) from Malik Table I (refPapers/NewPapers/figures/malik1990_table1_test_cases.png).
quantity: temporal frequency eigenvalue omega = omega_r + i*omega_i at fixed real alpha
verdict_reason: Second mode, temporal. pyMack omega=0.1158623+0.0001557i vs Malik 0.1158647+0.0001529i: omega_r rel err 2.08e-05 (0.002%), omega_i rel err 1.83e-02 (1.83%). Malik's deliberately SEVERE near-neutral M=10 test: omega_i ~ 1.5e-4 is strongly scheme-sensitive (his own SDSP even flips its sign at N+1=61). pyMack's independent IVM/RK4 cross-check value is 0.1158627+0.0001557i; pyMack lands on that cluster. Previously logged non-reproducible for lack of the dimensional conditions; adding the source paper (Table I) unlocked it. Mirror of validation/test_malik1990_case5_anchor.py.
pymack_provenance: pymack.solver.solve_temporal_compressible on CompressibleBlasiusProfile (adiabatic MEAN wall, Sutherland S=110.33 K) with ISOTHERMAL disturbance-temperature BC (T'|_wall=0, Malik's paper-wide convention; the mean wall is adiabatic but the perturbation T' vanishes at the wall), N=280, y_max=140, lambda_mu_ratio=1.2, length_scale='L_star'; mirrors validation/test_malik1990_case5_anchor.py.
